First, note offsets:  
Asia/Kolkata = UTC+5:30, US/Hawaii = UTC-10.  
Target time = 22:00 (June 17) + (-10 - 5.5) = 22:00 - 15.5 = 6:30 (June 17).  
But subtracting 15.5 hours from 22:00 goes back to previous day:  
22:00 - 15:30 = 6:30 on June 17? Let's check:  
22:00 - 12 hours = 10:00 June 17,  
subtract remaining 3.5 hours: 10:00 - 3:30 = 6:30 June 17.  
Wait, that’s still June 17. Actually, 22:00 - 15:30 = 6:30 same day. Yes, because 15.5 < 22.  

So no day change.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 06:30
